mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates a deteriorating economic cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0% and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing construction (HOUST > 550) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13200), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 60 trading days due to positive business sentiment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550 and GDPC1 > 13200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS rising for 3 consecutive months) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% indicates accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 550) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates a supportive monetary and housing environment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 550 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced industrial output and corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.
